answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 5000 garden for 7 horizon per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times the base cost. Each vote requires a 67% quorum and passes through 4 verification comet where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are withdrawn before the 7-day period ends.
